purpose: Prompts reutilizables para generar seis poses coherentes de Lulo antes de animarlo.
generator_instructions_es: Sube lulo_referencia_original.png a la herramienta de imágenes.
Pega el campo image_prompt_en de la variante deseada.
Activa fondo transparente si la herramienta lo permite.
Revisa que el sombrero vueltiao, los ojos y la cola mantengan el diseño original.
Guarda el resultado con el nombre indicado en output_file.

variants.description_es: Lulo saluda con la mano, sostiene el libro cerrado contra el pecho

art_direction.pose_en: gentle welcoming wave with one hand, holding blue book against chest
art_direction.face_en: joyful welcoming smile and soft eye contact

variants.image_prompt_en: Use the attached canonical reference image of Lulo as the strict character design reference. Lulo is a very cute, loving, child-friendly anthropomorphic green iguana mascot from the Colombian Caribbean, with warm brown expressive eyes, small turquoise skin freckles, creamy pale-yellow belly, gentle orange dorsal spines, a long curled tail, small tan explorer backpack, blue teaching book, and a traditional Colombian sombrero vueltiao in woven black and beige geometric patterns. Keep the face, head-to-body ratio, colors, hat, and silhouette faithful to the same single character. Premium polished 2D kids educational mascot illustration, rounded forms, clean outlines, soft shading, friendly expressions, centered full-body, transparent background, NO text, NO watermark, no extra characters. Specific scene: gentle welcoming wave with one hand, holding blue book against chest. Expression: joyful welcoming smile and soft eye contact. Keep the character identical to the reference.
